name: Driftweave Jogger — Elastic Ankle
description: Relaxed-fit joggers in heathered navy synth-cotton blend, with wide elastic waistband and tapered elastic ankles. Side seams have flat-felled finishing — durable, not decorative. A Circuit staple: wearable for a bar run, a market trip, or just existing on a day off.
functionality: Ankle elastics keep out wind and lake spray; deep side pockets fit a commuter card, snacks, and a hand tool.
what_it_says: You value comfort over performance and practicality over trend.
worn_by: Circuit factory workers on days off
story_hooks: The tail-gusset on the back seam was added by a Circuit tailor who didn't mark it — someone with a geneware tail modified this pair.
A Circuit bar has a running tab system; regulars who show up in Driftweave Joggers get a quiet discount.

physical_description.visual_profile: Relaxed, lived-in silhouette with a slight taper at the ankles. The heathered navy creates a soft, understated presence—neither aggressively casual nor trying to signal wealth. Reads as effortless streetwear comfort.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the hips and thighs with a gentle taper at the elastic ankles. The wide waistband sits naturally at the hip without cinching. Designed for movement and layering, not compression.
physical_description.primary_material: Heathered navy synth-cotton blend—a durable, breathable hybrid that mimics natural cotton while offering better stain resistance and longevity in urban environments.
physical_description.texture: Soft, slightly napped surface with visible fiber variation from the heather weave. The fabric has subtle texture without being rough; elastic ankles and waistband are smooth, ribbed construction.
physical_description.color_scheme: Heathered navy—a muted, multi-tone blue-grey that reads as neutral. No patterns or accent colors; the visual interest comes entirely from the fabric's natural heather variation.
physical_description.closures: Wide elastic waistband with internal drawstring for adjustment. Tapered elastic ankles with no additional closure—friction-fit design.
distinctive_features: Flat-felled side seams—a durable, functional construction detail that prevents fraying and signals quality workmanship without calling attention to itself
Wide elastic waistband designed for comfort over multiple body types and under layers
Tapered elastic ankles that work with boots, augmentation rigs, or barefoot movement
Unmarked—no visible branding or logos; authenticity through anonymity
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional. Affordable, durable, and designed for workers and street dwellers who need clothing that performs without pretense.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by Circuit denizens, delivery runners, warehouse staff, and anyone living day-to-day in the GLMZ. Signals practicality over status. Often paired with whatever's at hand—corpo overshirts, street tech, medical wraps.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in after a few weeks of wear. The heather weave shows minor fading in high-friction zones (waistband, inner thighs). Small pulls or pilling may appear; the flat-felled seams hold firm. This is a garment that ages gracefully into utility.
